Below is a single *SEARCH/REPLACE* patch for `src/languages/elixir.js` that expands the numeric regex to also match

  • a bare `0`  
  • floats starting with `0` (e.g. `0.3`)  
  • decimal integers with a leading `0` (e.g. `0123`)  
  • negative variants of all of the above (e.g. `-0`, `-0.3`, `-0123`, `-0xFF`, etc.)

Explanation of the new pattern:

- `-?`               optional minus
- `\b0o[0-7_]+`      octal
- `\b0b[01_]+`       binary
- `\b0x[0-9a-fA-F_]+` hexadecimal
- `\b0(?:\.[0-9_]+(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)?`  
                      `[0]`, or floats beginning with `0.` plus optional exponent
- `\b[1-9][0-9_]*(?:\.[0-9_]+(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)?`  
                      non-zero decimals and floats

This will highlight `0`, `0123`, `0.3`, `1.3`, `-0`, `-0.5`, `-0123`, etc., as numbers.
